# Billy Andrews

## Overview

- **Age:** twenty  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 ch.Proposal P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005), [v3 ch.Proposal P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 ch.Proposal P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## Appearance

Billy Andrews is a large and heavy-set young man with a broad, freckled, and expressionless round face.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 ch.Autumn P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004)_

## Personality

A big, fat youth of twenty, Billy Andrews is characterized by his round, expressionless face and a stolid demeanor. He suffers from a painful lack of conversational ability and is notably shy.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 ch.Proposal P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012)_

## History

Billy Andrews was given the upper farm in his own name by his father, leaving him in a position to get married. He provided carriage rides for [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) to and from the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) for a charity concert where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) performed successfully.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P4](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P33](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P34](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. ## Relationships

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/billy-andrews--jane-andrews.md)

[Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) is Billy's sister. They live in the same community and share transportation, such as when Billy drives [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to and from the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) charity concert. [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) also attends community events alongside Billy, including a farewell party thrown for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) before they leave for college.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P4](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P27](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0027), +13 more_
